ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web shown, which organism will be most directly impacted if the number of ants decreases?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the image is labeled plant, ant, lizard, poison dart, leimadopis epinephelus, the goliath bird eating spider. An arrow points from plant to ant, and another points from plant to poison dart; from ant downward points to lizard; from poison dart points to leimadopis epinephelus; then from leimadopis epinephelus points to the goliath bird eating spider. Then reason: the question asks which organism is most directly affected when the number of ants decreases. The arrow directly connected to ant and using ant as a food source points to lizard, therefore a decrease in ants will most directly affect lizard.
